name: Home
description: EXP-011 §76 fixture: a text input feeds a Variable that feeds a Pattern Extractor's Text; a button fires Extract over an authored pattern ((\d+)% — the percentage in a status line); Match, First Group, Match Count and Error are four Texts; Matches feeds a For Each of MatchRow; Found and Not Found each remember a word in a Variable shown in a fifth Text; Done writes the Match Count into a Variable shown in a sixth.
